msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands! Since it’s been 3 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course.

Both include the boat trip and diving equipment; Fun Dives also includes lunch. The online prices include the 10% online discount. The refresher uses a course medical form.

Payment is made through the online booking link, not in cash on the boat. International guests pay 100% by card online; Colombian nationals and residents of Colombia pay in COP. The price is the same in either currency, and the online discount is applied automatically.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. I'm German by the way. So what's the plan, the refresher on day one and normal dives on day two? Does the refresher day include lunch too?
reply:
Yes, the refresher on day one is a pool review and practice session, followed by one reef dive with a PADI instructor. It includes lunch. The refresher price from Cartagena is **183 USD online** or **204 USD regular**.

I can’t confirm from the details here whether you can add regular dives on a second day. The refresher includes boat transport from Cartagena to the islands and back on the same day.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: Just me. Of course I can dive a second day, no? Refresher on Monday and the 2 fun dives on Wednesday. Can I book both?
reply:
Yes, you can plan the refresher for Monday and the two Fun Dives for Wednesday. You can book each activity through its own online link; the website applies the 10% online discount automatically.

**Refresher:** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en  
**Fun Dives – 2 dives:** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

International guests pay by card on the website. Please bring your certified diver card or show a photo of it. 😊

✅ *Refresher added* — the guide runs the in-water review before the dive. It costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
